captions: The alarm rings. Your thumb knows the way.
Snooze. Snooze. Five more minutes, every time.
Outside, the sky turns light. Fajr slips away.
You wake up at nine. Tired, and a little empty.
The next day, 5:40. One alarm. Across the room.
You get up. Cold water on your face.
Empty roads. Streetlights. Just you, and the adhan.
Two rak'ahs. The best five minutes of your day.
